description: List proactive post suggestions: evidence-based weekly drafts posterly writes in each account's learned voice, each with a rationale tying it back to what has performed well for that account. The caption, rationale, and account id are returned in full. Filter by account_id and status (pending, scheduled, dismissed; default pending). The output says whether every matching suggestion is shown; page with offset until it does. Read-only; requires a Pro plan or higher. Use dismiss_suggestion to hide one, or pass save_as_draft true on that tool to keep it as an unpublished draft.

account_id.description: Filter to one social account ID (from list_accounts).

offset.description: How many suggestions to skip. Use the offset the previous page gives to get the next page.

name: list_post_suggestions
